description:
Take your next 3D project on the road with Blender and IntelCore Ultra X9 processors. With Blender's real-time 3D rendering plus the portability of new Intel-powered lightweight laptops, you can design, animate, model, and create—at home and on the go.

About Intel:
Intel, the world leader in silicon innovation, develops technologies, products and initiatives to continually advance how people work and live. This decade, our mission is to create and extend computing technology to connect and enrich the lives of every person on Earth.
